head_commit.message:
Merge pull request #1: v1.0.4 reliability round

Reliability fixes (quiet panic, --help, signal lifecycle, manifest lookup, action pinning), the init --ci --published post-release gate, race detector in CI, adversarial input validation for generated workflows, and docs honesty corrections.

Independently reviewed before merge: local build/vet/gofmt/test green, fetch suite 30/30, pins clean, published gate verified against real v1.0.3 assets (good PASS / damaged FAIL / platform-skip exit 3), CI 22 checks green on 7a2a82d and docs commit 54ef371.
